scope: Final independent answer audit integrated for all 100 questions. 'verified' means source-supported independent verification, not an authenticated MPPSC key; 10 previously unkeyed items were resolved, and 11 defective or genuinely ambiguous items remain unkeyed with documented uncertainty. Every question carries a full four-part explanation, including the unkeyed items.
